# RuView Local Deployment Changelog

## [2.1.0-release] - 2026-08-10
### Added
- Zero-intervention automated installer `install-ruview.sh`.
- ESP32-S3 and ESP32-C6 USB serial port auto-detection & chip inspection.
- Local 4-bit quantized WiFi-DensePose model caching (`ruvnet/wifi-densepose-pretrained`).
- Home Assistant MQTT Auto-Discovery for 21 spatial entities (11 raw signal sensors + 10 semantic activity states).
- 17-Point RuView Doctor & System Verification Matrix (`ruview doctor`).
- Management CLI (`ruview`) supporting backup, restore, flash, provision, update, and uninstall.
